svg.title: k8n
svg.desc: k8n: a visual IDE for Kubernetes. Draw your app as a graph; k8n writes the YAML, shows the diff and deploys only after you approve it. One binary for Windows, macOS and Linux. An AI assistant proposes fixes that you approve. The drawing shows Ingress, Service and Deployment nodes, with a new ConfigMap waiting for approval. Built with Go, Next.js and Kubernetes.
